channel.title: The Coastland Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Coastland Times (thecoastlandtimes.com)

item.title: Kill Devil Hills man arrested for failure to report new address for sex offender registration
item.description: The Dare County Sheriff’s Office has reported the arrest of a Kill Devil Hills man for failing to report a new address for purposes of sex offender registration.

item.title: With court relief, work resumes on Virginia offshore wind
item.description: When fully operational, CVOW’s 176 wind turbines will generate enough energy to power up to 660,000 homes, making it the largest offshore wind farm in the U.S.

item.title: Frank Stick Memorial Art Show award recipients named
item.description: The 48th Annual Frank Stick Memorial Art Show is Dare Arts’ largest show to date with 114 artworks submitted by local and regional artists.

item.title: Referendum for Dare Parks and Recreation funding approved for November ballot
item.description: The referendum allows Dare County voters to decide whether to fund the Parks & Recreation Recommendations and Implementation Plan developed by McGill & Associates.

item.title: Letter to the Editor: Need what?
item.description: There are so many specialized and unique needs. A simple police car, for example, is not simple at all.

item.title: The Rustic Mermaid Vendor Market brings fresh, creative shopping experience to the Outer Banks
item.description: The Outer Banks has a new destination for shoppers, makers and treasure-seekers: The Rustic Mermaid Vendor Market in Kill Devil Hills.

item.title: Social Security Matters: Ask Rusty – Should I claim Social Security early because it is 'going bankrupt?'
item.description: The fact is, Social Security still has about $2.7 trillion in reserved funds which are now being used to pay full benefits.

item.title: First Flight girls second at state indoor track meet
item.description: Distance runners Kayla Folkes and Morgan Miller helped pace the First Flight High School girls indoor track team to a second place finish at the 4A NCHSAA State Championships in Winston-Salem.

item.title: Who Really Benefits From Cashback Casino Bonuses?
item.description: There’s been a noticeable rise in people searching for cashback casino bonuses available on AskGamblers.

item.title: Emergency Steps to Take Following a Crash in Remote Coastal North Carolina in 2026
item.description: Driving in remote coastal areas like Dare and Hyde counties can be especially dangerous, with storms and road closures—such as past shutdowns of Highway 12 on Ocracoke and Pea Island—sometimes isolating communities and delaying emergency response.
